verdict.rationale: The evidence shows skill-creator can 'benchmark skill performance with variance analysis' as a feature offered to end-users, but there's no evidence that Anthropic itself maintains a test/eval suite for the official skills collection to catch regressions before shipping changes. Community reports (comm-6 through comm-14) actually describe unpredictable, hit-or-miss triggering behavior, suggesting no rigorous regression testing is evident in practice.
